ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels dominating the central and lower regions, and 30% high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels concentrated on the distal lateral margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central low-intensity zone is largely contiguous. Distal high-intensity zones on both left and right lobes exhibit high-frequency low-intensity mottling and discrete dark circular nodes (blobs) particularly visible on the right lobe distal tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped indentation with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 42 degrees and a bounding-box depth of approximately 15% of the total vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge boundary with pixel-amplitude variations ranging from 3 to 18 pixels; a significant jagged notch is visible on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the distal trailing edge transition into a convex outer leading edge trajectory.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatially distinct high-contrast circular rings (white on black) located on the medial-left lobe; matching dark circular nodes (black on white) located on the distal-right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, near-parallel high-intensity linear streaks (rake marks) oriented diagonally on the medial portion of the right lobe pigment.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Circular scarring consistent with rosette-pattern parasitic lesions or previous barnacle attachment sites; significant irregular tissue loss/notching on the right lobe trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Heavy accumulation of high-density, irregular-textured calcified clusters (barnacles) localized at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes.
